rows: all = valid particles; predicted = all minus rigid actuators and fixtures; moving = predicted rows that leave their last context position by 5.0 mm or more within the scored frames
numbers: mm; zero = predict no motion, hold = hold the last context velocity; mean over scored frames and rows of one clip (the per-clip averaging of TrajectoryScores), _final = at the last scored frame; motion_mm_per_frame = mean step of the predicted rows over the scored transitions

windows.selection: the prefix window (frames 0..C+F-1) of every test episode, shards in sorted order
windows.evaluator: eval_unified.py --clips all (the loader's own order, no row sets), or eval_unified.py --cases <this manifest> --case_set windows --clips all

rollouts_first.selection: every test episode rolled out whole from frame 0
